articles.title: Injured Red Sox infielder out of cast, hopes to return in time for playoffs
articles.description: Finally out of a cast, injured Red Sox infielder Curtis Mead was on the field pregame running through drills as he works to try and return before the end of the season.

articles.title: Sonny Gray says decision to push back start has been a month in the making
articles.description: Sonny Gray’s next start has been pushed back an extra three days to Saturday, but the Red Sox starter says that decision has actually been in the works for nearly a month.

articles.title: Red Sox place All-Star first baseman on injured list, recall Mickey Gasper
articles.description: After battling through a hamstring issue for several weeks, the Red Sox finally placed their All-Star first baseman on the injured list to help get him right for the final push.

articles.title: Red Sox broadcaster apologizes after urging pitcher to fight Yankees star
articles.description: Red Sox radio broadcaster Will Flemming apologized Monday, saying his comments regarding Yankees infielder Jazz Chisholm Jr. crossed a line.

articles.title: Controversial call helps doom Red Sox as Yankees clinch season series
articles.description: The Red Sox lost after allowing five runs in the fifth following a controversial call, potentially swinging the AL Wild Card race decisively in the Yankees’ favor.

articles.title: Red Sox activate Roman Anthony and Trevor Story, option recent standouts
articles.description: The Red Sox activated Roman Anthony and Trevor Story prior to Sunday’s series finale, but to clear space on the roster they had to option two key contributors to the club’s recent success.

articles.title: College coach on Cam Schlittler’s fast rise: ‘I’m not completely surprised’
articles.description: Few expected Cam Schlittler would become a Cy Young contender, but Mike Glavine, who grew up watching his brother’s Hall of Fame career, isn’t surprised to see his former Northeastern star succeed.

articles.title: Brayan Bello allows four runs, Red Sox bats fall silent in Game 2 loss
articles.description: The Red Sox bats fell silent on Saturday night as the Yankees took the second game of the doubleheader.

articles.title: Jake Bennett dominates as Red Sox top Yankees in first game of doubleheader
articles.description: Jake Bennett pitched brilliantly and the Red Sox bats erupted in the ninth to take the first game of Saturday’s doubleheader against the Yankees.

articles.title: Red Sox activate key reliever ahead of Yankees doubleheader
articles.description: The Red Sox are getting one of their best relievers back ahead of Saturday’s doubleheader against the Yankees.

articles.title: Red Sox shut out by Yankees in pivotal series opener
articles.description: The Red Sox were shut out for the second straight game in Friday’s pivotal series opener against the Yankees.

articles.title: Opportunity knocks as Red Sox open crucial four-game series with Yankees
articles.description: The last time the Red Sox faced the Yankees they completed a four-game sweep. They haven’t looked back since, and this weekend they’ll have a chance to finally catch their rivals in the standings.

articles.title: Red Sox shut out by Marlins, win streak snapped at five
articles.description: The Red Sox saw their five-game win streak snapped after getting shut out by the Marlins in Wednesday’s series finale.

articles.title: Jarren Duran hits grand slam in 11th inning to power Red Sox past Marlins
articles.description: Mickey Gasper homered twice and Jarren Duran broke things open with a grand slam in the 11th inning to power the Red Sox past the Marlins.

articles.title: Red Sox infielder inspired by memory of late college friend
articles.description: Caleb Durbin has shown a willingness to play through pain, but a messed up pinky is nothing compared to what the Red Sox third baseman once watched one of his closest friends battle through.

articles.title: Red Sox rally past Marlins to complete fourth straight comeback win
articles.description: The Red Sox rallied for their fourth consecutive comeback win on Monday, holding the Marlins to 2 for 18 with runners in scoring position in the process.
